mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in fewer than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate within one month signals aggressive monetary tightening, triggering immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS show positive growth over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes, persistent job market weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production reflects expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days without specific triggers.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO trend is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60d forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth falls below 0.5% annualized, it indicates economic deceleration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to deteriorating growth prospects.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% in the last quarter
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent deceleration in employment growth and rising unemployment indicate a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS growth is negative and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes, sustained CPI growth above 3.0% annually signals central bank intervention, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% annually.
